units.source_text: 丈夫将公文包往化妆桌边上一扔，蓦地抓住夫人的肩膀，

en.t: The husband tossed his briefcase down beside the dressing table and suddenly seized his wife's shoulders,

units.source_text: 你爱读的小说上是不是写着：

en.t: Doesn't it say in those novels you love to read:

units.source_text: 拥有着迷于化妆，甚至连丈夫回家的声响都听不见的妻子的男人很幸福？”

en.t: A man is very happy if he has a wife so absorbed in her makeup that she cannot even hear the sound of her husband coming home?"
